So they only list bribery. For case with both, they listed both. So we need decide if there is abuse of power. The facts: He used his position to help them win bids. That's abuse of power. But the primary crime is bribery. The prosecution may also charge "滥用职权". In example with姜1某, they had both because there were two separate acts: abuse of power (signing forms) and bribery.
